audit.summary: The 320×480 ad unit has a functional layout with proper branding, product imagery, and CTA placement. However, there are three findings: (1) The carousel pagination dots are visible but only one slide is shown across all three states (initial, animated, settled), which violates the rule that orphan dots must be hidden when fewer than 2 distinct slides are present. (2) The primary CTA button appears to have insufficient bottom margin relative to the ad frame edge, risking a flush appearance. (3) Minor color and typography polish issues with secondary accent text.

findings.issue: Carousel pagination dots visible with only 1 working slide across all states (initial, animated, settled). No slide transition or multiple distinct product views are shown; dots should be hidden when carousel has ≤1 functional slide.
findings.fix_hint: Hide pagination dots via CSS: #ad-320x480 .carousel-dots { display: none; } or add hidden attribute to dot container if only single hero image state is intended.

findings.issue: Primary CTA button ('J'EN PROFITE') appears visually close to bottom edge of ad frame with minimal visible gap. Safe zone requires ≥20px padding below CTA to frame boundary.
findings.fix_hint: Add padding-bottom to CTA container: #ad-320x480 .cta-button { margin-bottom: 24px; } or wrap CTA in a footer div with padding-bottom: 20px;

findings.issue: Secondary italic tagline 'Jusqu'à -50%' and 'réservée aux KusmiKlubbers' text uses Playfair Display italic, but color contrast or opacity against dark navy hero section could be refined for readability.
findings.fix_hint: Ensure italic accent text has sufficient contrast: review color property (should be #F4ECDC or #FFFFFF) and verify font-size is ≥12px for legibility in italic style.
